bio: Once a student pub, Caro's is just a stone's throw from the beautiful Marktplatz and Rathaus. The restaurant is laid out over two floors and boasts a cosy interior featuring wood panelling and furnishings. In summer, tables are set up outside on the pavement. The menu comprises fresh contemporary cuisine, from ceviche to Iberico pork chop and sea bream, but there are also vegetarian options. Across the street, Speisekammer is a delicatessen under the same management, which sells high-quality foods and spirits....
